bootstrap_spec.unit: evaluation race (resample the 5 evaluation races with replacement; preserve all rows of selected races; recompute race-macro metric; compute paired delta). Row-level bootstrapping is prohibited for primary uncertainty.

next_stage_consequence: research result only; no serving promotion under any gate outcome; product decisions belong to later V3.8 stages
primary_metric: race-macro binary log loss over evaluation races
revealed_corpus_limitation: V3.8E exists because D examined this historical corpus and warranted fusion research; the D corpus is therefore REVEALED for the decision to perform E. Source predictions remain temporally OOF, but the decision to investigate fusion was made after D examined the corpus. This limitation appears prominently in every E card/report.
source_lineage: V3_1B_LOGISTIC (raw independent-binary WIN) + MC2_E (mutually-exclusive simulation WIN frequency); V3.5 P_win excluded as SHARED_OR_DERIVED_LINEAGE; V3.4 excluded; XGBoost secondary-only (SECONDARY_XGB_FUSION_NOT_REQUIRED)
source_probability_families: independent-binary vs mutually-exclusive frequency; fusion is per-row binary WIN probability, never race-normalized
tie_break: among exact ties on the tuning objective, choose the largest alpha (defaults toward the frozen Logistic champion rather than inventing additional simulation influence); deterministic
tuning_objective: race-macro binary log loss over PRIOR (history) races only. Pooled-loss tuning, evaluation-race tuning, and continuous post-hoc alpha optimization are prohibited.
